key-refused: TMDb refused the key (401 Unauthorized). Enter the API Read Access Token from themoviedb.org → Settings → API, not the shorter API key.
not-tmdb: The service at this address answered, but not the way TMDb's API does. Check the address: TMDb's is https://api.themoviedb.org.
api-not-found: TMDb's API wasn't found at this address (404 Not Found). Use https://api.themoviedb.org.
too-many-requests: TMDb is asking the app to slow down (429 Too Many Requests), and still was after three retries. Try again in a minute.

not-found.movie: TMDb has no movie with the id {{id}}.
not-found.show: TMDb has no show with the id {{id}}.
not-found.episode: TMDb has no episode {{episode}} of season {{season}} of the show {{show}}.
not-found.collection: TMDb has no collection with the id {{id}}.
not-found.person: TMDb has no person with the id {{id}}.

poster.not-an-image: TMDb's image host answered the poster with something other than a JPEG or PNG image.
poster.none: TMDb's image host has no poster at {{path}}.
